name: Step 1: User Schema Setup
description: Create the Users Table schema in the database. Modify the database/models/User.js file to define the user model with attributes: id, name, email, password, and role. Establish relationships with other tables as necessary. Implement password hashing using a library like bcrypt.

name: Step 2: Lead Capture and Management API
description: Develop the Core Module's lead capture functionality. Create API endpoints in routes/lead.js for creating, reading, updating, and deleting (CRUD) leads. Define the Leads Table schema with columns: id, name, phone_number, source, and status. Implement API validation and error handling using a library like Joi.

name: Step 3: Conversation History and Follow-ups
description: Design and implement the conversation history and follow-up reminders features. Create the Conversations Table and FollowUps Table schemas. Develop API endpoints in routes/conversation.js and routes/followup.js to manage conversation history and follow-ups. Integrate with the Leads Table to associate conversations and follow-ups with specific leads.

name: Step 4: Billing and Subscription Management
description: Implement the Billing Module's subscription management functionality. Create the Subscriptions Table and Payments Table schemas. Develop API endpoints in routes/subscription.js and routes/payment.js to manage subscription plans and payment records. Integrate with a payment gateway like Stripe to process payments and update the Payments Table accordingly.

name: Step 5: User Dashboard and Analytics
description: Develop the dashboard feature to display lead conversion rates, conversation history, and follow-up reminders. Create API endpoints in routes/dashboard.js to fetch and display relevant data. Implement data visualization using a library like Chart.js to display key metrics and KPIs. Ensure the dashboard is accessible only to authenticated users with the appropriate role-based access control.
